evals.prompt: Take a screenshot from execute_mc_jsmacros on the Minecraft 26.1.2 client and return the callback result.
evals.expected_output: Uses the runtime-verified 2-argument Player.takeScreenshot(folder, callback), dispatches with Client.runOnMainThread(callback, true, 8000), transfers callback text through GlobalVars.putString/getString, waits on the script thread, and accounts for the <macroFolder>/<folder>/screenshots output shape.

evals.prompt: Tell me where the client is, what it is looking at, the open screen, dimension and biome.
evals.expected_output: Uses Player, World and Hud APIs and returns primitive structured state.

evals.prompt: Break block 100 64 -30 through JsMacros and report the before/after block IDs.
Find minecraft:stone in inventory and move one stack to hotbar slot 0.
Check whether this PUA menu glyph is actually loaded client-side without relying only on visual guessing.
evals.expected_output: Can discover Chat.getTextWidth and use client text width as a measurable signal.

evals.prompt: Item getNBT is breaking on enchanted items on this 26.1.2 client. Investigate the exact JsMacros version context.
evals.expected_output: Finds the v2.0.3 registry-reference NBT fix and the 26.1.2 version pairing.

evals.prompt: Save a screenshot as gtc-menu.png with JsMacros 2.0.3.
evals.expected_output: Finds the target-runtime fact that Player.takeScreenshot(folder,file,callback) throws ArithmeticException: / by zero. Uses the generated-name overload for the working screenshot path and reports the generated filename from the callback.

evals.prompt: Screenshot callback says Couldn't save screenshot and no exception was thrown. Explain the exact path behavior seen on this client.
evals.expected_output: Reports that folder is used as a parent and the downstream screenshot helper adds screenshots; folder='screenshots' produced <macroFolder>/screenshots/screenshots/<timestamp>.png, and the directory had to exist before the successful run.

evals.prompt: My screenshot happens, but assigning the callback result to a local JS variable still returns null. Use the verified pattern.
evals.expected_output: Uses GlobalVars.putString inside the callback and GlobalVars.getString from the script thread after Client.waitTick; retains JavaWrapper.methodToJava and main-thread dispatch.
